steps.en: Fill backend/.env (Boat key, Fernet key, hook secret, public tunnel URL) and start everything
steps.zh: 填好 Boat key、加密密钥、hook 口令和隧道地址，启动

steps.en: Starts PostgreSQL, runs migrations, launches the API, the Telegram bot and the web UI
steps.zh: 拉起 PostgreSQL、跑迁移，启动 API、Telegram 机器人和网页

steps.en: Send /connect to the bot, finish Claude's OAuth login and paste the code back
steps.zh: 给机器人发 /connect，完成 Claude 登录，把授权码贴回去

steps.en: Creates a Boat sandbox, copies Claude's credential out of it, encrypts and stores it
steps.zh: 开一台 Boat 沙箱，取出 Claude 凭据，加密后存库

steps.en: Send any plain message as the task
steps.zh: 随便发一句普通消息，就是任务

steps.en: Writes the permission hook into the sandbox and runs Claude Code headless on your prompt
steps.zh: 往沙箱写入权限 hook，用你的指令无界面跑 Claude Code

steps.en: When a risky action pauses the task, tap Allow once, Always allow or Deny
steps.zh: 风险动作把任务停住时，点允许一次、总是允许或拒绝

steps.en: Resumes or blocks the action, then replies in the chat with the result
steps.zh: 放行或拦下该动作，跑完把结果回复到聊天里

value.en: You run Claude Code tasks from your phone in a throwaway cloud VM and see every risky action before it happens — no laptop session to babysit
value.zh: 在手机上派 Claude Code 去一次性云虚拟机里干活，风险动作先过你，不用守着电脑

sources: https://github.com/Anil-matcha/open-dots/blob/main/README.md Quick start (cp backend/.env.example backend/.env; BOAT_API_KEY, TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEYS, HOOK_TOKEN, PERMISSION_HOOK_BASE_URL; ./scripts/dev.sh starts Postgres, migrations, FastAPI, the Telegram bot and the web UI)

https://github.com/Anil-matcha/open-dots/blob/main/README.md 'Using Open Dots' / 'In Telegram' (/start, /connect creates a sandbox and returns a login URL, paste the code back; send any message, e.g. 'create a webpage that says hello')
https://github.com/Anil-matcha/open-dots/blob/main/README.md 'Permission prompts' (PermissionRequest hook, Allow once / Always allow / Deny buttons, 110s timeout to deny)

backend/app/services/auth_flow_service.py (claude auth login; credential_path .claude/.credentials.json) and backend/app/services/task_execution_service.py (writes .claude/settings.json PermissionRequest http hook; runs claude -p {prompt} --output-format json)
